THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
RUNWAY
074
STUDY 040
Camel Suede Trench with Cape Collar
Rights check
Source: 24386.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wind-swept light
brown hair walks a runway. She wears a long camel
suede trench coat with a deep cape collar fastened with
a buckle clasp, a self-tie belt at the waist, and cuffed
sleeves. Brown knee-high boots show at the hem. Her
expression is calm and direct. A dark wooden wall
behind her, a purple carpet runway, and warm stage
lighting. Palette of camel, chocolate, and violet. Elegant
and dramatic, in the style of a fall runway editorial.
Elegant, dramatic, structured
WORKING NOTES
- The cape collar and belt are the defining structure.
- Add 'mid-stride' to capture the walking motion.
